items.name: Lanop Accountancy
items.subject: A referral idea for your freelancer and consultant clients
items.body:
Hi,

Your site says Lanop works with freelancers, consultants and creative professionals, with accounting tailored to how they actually work. That caught my attention.

I'm Joel Ezekiel, a Qualified Financial Planner with an MSc in Behavioural Economics who coaches self-employed people on the behaviour side of money. My 12-week one-to-one programme builds each client a Cash Flow Plan.

So the gap I fill is the bit before the numbers land on your desk: why money stays stressful on a decent income, and simple systems that stick.

I think there's a clean two-way referral here. You handle the tax and the books, I handle the behaviour and the Cash Flow Plan.

Would a quick call to see if this works both ways be useful?

Joel
